Bookmark this page for the latest news, rumblings and analysis from ESPN's insiders.</description><pubDate>Fri, 06 Nov 2026 21:57:15 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/0301/r1621468_608x342_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Ex-NBA player Ed Davis expected to change plea to guilty in sports betting case</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50401571/ex-nba-player-ed-davis-plead-guilty-sports-betting-case</link><description>Former NBA player Ed Davis is expected to change his plea to guilty in his federal sport betting case, according a court docket entry filed on Friday.</description><pubDate>Fri, 06 Nov 2026 20:40:15 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1025/r1736092_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Knicks 'appreciative' of Taylor Swift after Kolek, McBride question fandom</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50401522/knicks-appreciative-taylor-swift-players-comments</link><description>The Knicks have come to the defense of Taylor Swift and say they are "incredibly appreciative" of her support after Tyler Kolek and Miles "Deuce" McBride named her as the fakest celebrity fan at games.</description><pubDate>Fri, 06 Nov 2026 20:37:35 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/0611/r1671292_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Knicks defend Taylor Swift's fandom after Tyler Kolek, Miles McBride weigh in</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50401300/taylor-swift-knicks-fan-tyler-kolek-miles-mcbride</link><description>Swift's history at Madison Square Garden includes courtside appearances dating back to 2014 and her July wedding to Travis Kelce.</description><pubDate>Fri, 06 Nov 2026 20:12:51 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/0611/r1671292_608x342_16-9.jpg" /></item></channel></rss>
